policy_statement: Track changes in community greenhouse gas emissions annually (building on the 2009 community inventory).
source_quote: Salt Lake City first published a community greenhouse gas inventory for 2009 and tracks changes in emissions annually. The City is part of national and international efforts committed to the tracking, reporting and reduction of carbon emissions, including the Carbon Disclosure Project (CDP), Compact of Mayors and Mayors National Climate Action Agenda.
extraction_rationale: Concrete ongoing MRV commitment (annual tracking of emissions) that supports mitigation governance and accountability.

policy_statement: Achieve an 80% net reduction in carbon pollution through reducing energy waste and transitioning to renewable energy.
source_quote: For Salt Lake City to become Climate Positive the reduction of energy waste and transition to renewable energy must be sizable enough to produce an 80% net reduction in carbon pollution. This transformation can also ensure the growth of green local jobs, enhanced self-reliance, a cleaner environment and improved public health.
extraction_rationale: Quantified emissions-reduction target (80% net reduction) with explicit mechanisms.

policy_statement: Ensure renewable energy provides 100% of community electricity needs by 2032.
source_quote: Salt Lake City is working to ensure that renewable energy provides 100% of community electricity needs by 2032. This goal is foundational to the success of Climate Positive given that more than 50% of community carbon pollution is associated with electricity generation.
extraction_rationale: Quantified clean electricity target with a deadline (100% by 2032).

policy_statement: Commission a third-party study on pathways to 100% renewable energy (with Summit County and Park City), to be published in early 2017.
source_quote: Renewable Energy Feasibility Study: The City partnered with Summit County and Park City to commission a third-party study on pathways to 100% renewable energy for each individual community. This study will be published in early 2017 and help inform ongoing priorities and investments.
extraction_rationale: Specific named intervention (commissioned third-party study) with a publication timeline.

policy_statement: Encourage customer-side investments in renewable options like rooftop solar.
source_quote: Sustained Growth of Rooftop Solar: Households and businesses play an essential role in reducing carbon pollution and the City encourages customer-side investments in renewable options like rooftop solar. Net metered solar installations in Salt Lake City grew at roughly exponential rates from 2010-16, helping empower residents and create local jobs.
extraction_rationale: Specific intervention area (rooftop solar) with explicit City encouragement; non-quantified but action-oriented.

policy_statement: Advance public transit improvements via the Transit Master Plan and continued collaboration with UTA on enhanced service options.
source_quote: The City released its first Transit Master Plan in 2016 and continues to collaborate with Utah Transit Authority (UTA) on enhanced service options. Affordability is also crucial and served as a catalyst for the discounted transit Hive Pass for City residents.
extraction_rationale: Concrete planning instrument and ongoing collaboration to expand/enhance public transit service.

policy_statement: Invest in infrastructure to support active, zero-emissions transportation options such as walking and biking.
source_quote: Promoting Active Transportation. The Salt Lake City Transportation Division has developed plans and invested in infrastructure to support active, zero-emissions transportation options such as walking and biking.
extraction_rationale: Specific infrastructure investment to support active transportation and reduce vehicle emissions.

policy_statement: Invest in public EV charging infrastructure and collaborate on programs to offer discounted EVs to residents.
source_quote: The City has invested in public EV charging infrastructure and collaborated on programs to offer discounted EVs to residents. Work on related initiatives, plus broader policy measures, will remain a priority for Salt Lake City going forward.
extraction_rationale: Specific interventions; discounted EV program constitutes a financial incentive instrument.

policy_statement: Offer the Hive Pass with a 50% discount to make transit more affordable and accessible for Salt Lake City residents.
source_quote: Ride with Hive. This program makes transit more affordable and accessible.
extraction_rationale: Quantified discount is a financial instrument to increase transit use (mode shift).

policy_statement: Sponsor the annual Clear the Air Challenge to reduce mobile-source emissions.
source_quote: In addition to encouraging active and public transportation as a tool for reducing mobile emissions sources, the City sponsors an annual Clear the Air Challenge. The program has reduced over 3,600 tons of carbon emissions since its inception in 2006.
extraction_rationale: Named annual program with quantified impact (over 3,600 tons of carbon emissions reduced since 2006).

policy_statement: Limit vehicle idling within Salt Lake City boundaries through the idle-free ordinance adopted in 2011.
source_quote: In 2011, the City adopted an idle-free ordiance to limit vehicle idling within Salt Lake City boundaries. ## Industry The Utah Department of Environmental Quality leads regulatory efforts related to local industry and the City supports strong pollution reduction programs. Reducing emissions from industry and area sources will become increasingly important as cleaner vehicles and fuels are adopted.
extraction_rationale: Binding regulatory mechanism (ordinance) to reduce idling-related emissions.

policy_statement: Implement Project Skyline to accelerate investment in energy efficiency and raise awareness of building energy performance among large commercial facilities.
source_quote: Project Skyline accelerates investment in energy efficiency and raises public awareness of building energy performance among the largest commercial facilities in Salt Lake City. The initiative also spurs job growth and fosters a stronger local economy. Building owners across the City are encouraged to pursue energy-saving targets by evaluating building energy use, setting energy savings goals and implementing cost-effective improvement projects.
extraction_rationale: Named program with explicit energy efficiency mechanisms (evaluate use, set goals, implement projects).

policy_statement: Encourage adoption of updated, increasingly efficient energy codes for new construction statewide.
source_quote: Salt Lake City will continue to encourage the adoption of updated, increasingly efficient energy codes that support a responsible built environment statewide. ## AIR QUALITY Salt Lake City faces significant air quality challenges year-round.
extraction_rationale: Commitment to pursue a regulatory lever (energy codes), though adopted at state level; still a defined policy action (advocacy).

policy_statement: Prioritize energy benchmarking and tune-ups for commercial buildings and provide guides for home improvements (thermostat controls, insulation, efficient appliances).
source_quote: Salt Lake City prioritizes energy benchmarking and tune-ups for commercial buildings through a combination of policy, incentives, and educational resources. The City also provides guides for home improvements, including details on thermostat controls, home insulation and efficient appliances, to help move residential buildings toward a cleaner energy future.
extraction_rationale: Specific energy efficiency interventions delivered through policy/incentives/education.

policy_statement: Partner with Rocky Mountain Power and Questar Gas to strengthen incentive offerings that reduce emissions and improve building performance.
source_quote: Rocky Mountain Power and Questar Gas offer incentive programs to reduce emissions and improve the performance of residential and non-residential properties. Partnering with these utilities is key to ensure the ongoing effectiveness of programs while also catalyzing more robust incentive offerings that eliminate pollution and save ratepayers money.
extraction_rationale: Partnership to catalyze/expand incentive offerings; incentives are financial instruments even if delivered by utilities.

policy_statement: Achieve Zero Waste by 2040 and divert, recycle or compost 70% of the waste stream by 2025 (joint resolution signed in 2011).
source_quote: Through a joint resolution signed in 2011, the City set a goal of Zero Waste by 2040 and a goal of diverting, recycling or composting 70% of the waste stream by 2025. In 2015-16 the City's Waste and Recycling Program diverted 40% of residential waste.
extraction_rationale: Quantified waste targets with deadlines set by resolution.

policy_statement: Require recycling of debris for major construction and renovation projects permitted by the City (Construction and Demolition Ordinance).
source_quote: The Construction and Demolition Ordinance requires recycling of debris for major construction and renovation projects permitted by the City. The Business Recycling Ordinance requires multi-family properties, businesses and special events to implement recycling programs beginning in 2017.
extraction_rationale: Binding ordinance requirement for construction/renovation debris recycling.

policy_statement: Require multi-family properties, businesses and special events to implement recycling programs beginning in 2017 (Business Recycling Ordinance).
source_quote: The Business Recycling Ordinance requires multi-family properties, businesses and special events to implement recycling programs beginning in 2017. Further plans work to enable three key strategies: ## Waste Reduction Establish fee structures for residential waste and recycling services that encourage the reduction of waste.
extraction_rationale: Binding ordinance with an implementation start date for recycling program requirements.

policy_statement: Establish fee structures for residential waste and recycling services that encourage waste reduction.
source_quote: Establish fee structures for residential waste and recycling services that encourage the reduction of waste. ## Increased Recycling Expand composting capability in the city to enable food waste diversion.
extraction_rationale: Explicit financial instrument (fees) designed to incentivize waste reduction.

policy_statement: Expand composting capability in the city to enable food waste diversion.
source_quote: Expand composting capability in the city to enable food waste diversion. ## Highest and Best Use Work with local and state partners to develop a long-term plan for regional materials management and explore recycling market development opportunities.
extraction_rationale: Specific intervention to divert food waste from landfill through expanded composting.

policy_statement: Work with local and state partners to develop a long-term plan for regional materials management and explore recycling market development opportunities.
source_quote: Work with local and state partners to develop a long-term plan for regional materials management and explore recycling market development opportunities. ## COLLABORATIVE SOLUTIONS Salt Lake City prioritizes collaboration to enhance understanding of climate risks and foster joint opportunities to reduce carbon pollution.
extraction_rationale: Concrete planning commitment to develop a long-term materials management plan and explore recycling market development.

policy_statement: Implement the Comprehensive Energy Management Executive Order requiring energy benchmarking, efficiency investments, facility operator training and employee engagement.
source_quote: The City adopted an Executive Order to enhance interdepartmental coordination, encourage energy waste reduction and spur the development of clean energy. This comprehensive Order requires measures such as energy benchmarking, efficiency investments, facility operator training and employee engagement.
extraction_rationale: Binding internal mechanism (Executive Order) with explicit required measures.

policy_statement: Require new Salt Lake City government facilities above 10,000 square feet to be constructed to Net Zero Energy standards and include renewables that offset annual carbon emissions.
source_quote: New Salt Lake City government facilities above 10,000 square feet, with the exception of certain use types, must be constructed to Net Zero Energy standards. These projects must include onsite and/or offsite renewable energy projects that offset the anticipated annual carbon emissions of the facility. The City's Public Safety Building was the first such project developed to meet this requirement.
extraction_rationale: Binding requirement ('must') with size threshold and explicit renewable offsets for annual carbon emissions.

policy_statement: Install renewable energy generation at at least 16 City government properties by the end of 2017.
source_quote: By the end of 2017, Salt Lake City will have at least 16 separate government properties that include renewable energy generation. The City has also enrolled in the Rocky Mountain Power 'Subscriber Solar' program and will receive the equivalent of three megawatts of solar power through this initiative.
extraction_rationale: Quantified deployment commitment with deadline.

policy_statement: Achieve 50% renewable electricity for Salt Lake City government operations by 2020.
source_quote: Salt Lake City is committed to achieving 50% renewable electricity for its government operations by 2020. ## Clean Vehicle Fleet Salt Lake City evaluates local air quality impacts, carbon pollution and financial viability when prioritizing fleet vehicle purchases and related operational strategies.
extraction_rationale: Quantified operational renewable electricity target with deadline.

policy_statement: Enroll in Rocky Mountain Power 'Subscriber Solar' program to receive the equivalent of three megawatts of solar power.
source_quote: The City has also enrolled in the Rocky Mountain Power 'Subscriber Solar' program and will receive the equivalent of three megawatts of solar power through this initiative. Salt Lake City is committed to achieving 50% renewable electricity for its government operations by 2020.
extraction_rationale: Specific procurement/enrollment action with quantified amount (three megawatts equivalent).

policy_statement: Evaluate air quality impacts, carbon pollution and financial viability when prioritizing City fleet vehicle purchases and operational strategies.
source_quote: Salt Lake City evaluates local air quality impacts, carbon pollution and financial viability when prioritizing fleet vehicle purchases and related operational strategies. Numerous departments and divisions at the City have developed Tailpipe Emissions Reduction Plans to inform their investments and operations.
extraction_rationale: Operational procurement policy guiding fleet purchases and strategies using emissions/air-quality criteria.

policy_statement: Reduce consumable food waste as a key goal of the Climate Positive sustainable food program.
source_quote: Reduce consumable food waste. Currently, 40% of food purchased in the U.S. goes to waste.
extraction_rationale: Specific intervention goal within the sustainable food program; non-quantified but clearly action-oriented.

policy_statement: Improve local, low carbon and diversified food production by shifting from carbon intensive meat and dairy practices to diverse produce production methods.
source_quote: Improve local, low carbon and diversified food production. In Utah, only 2% of vegetables and 3% of fruit consumed is in grown in-state. To create a more resilient food system, the community must shift from carbon intensive meat and dairy agricultural practices to more diverse produce production methods.
extraction_rationale: Defined shift in production practices; framed as needed to build resilience and reduce carbon intensity.

policy_statement: Support the Salt Lake City Food Policy Task Force to identify opportunities to increase access to fresh and nutritious food for all City residents.
source_quote: The Salt Lake City Food Policy Task Force (FPTF) is comprised of a diverse group of individuals and organizations interested in improving food policy in Salt Lake City. They work with the City to identify opportunities to increase access to fresh and nutritious food for all City residents: Culinary Incubator Kitchen gives food businesses an advantage in the local marketplace by providing an affordable kitchen space for food prep as well as business marketing tools and resources.
section_header: Investments in Local and Sustainable Food
extraction_rationale: Named institutional mechanism working with the City to identify food policy opportunities; concrete intervention though not quantified.

policy_statement: Provide resources through Dining with Discretion to empower residents to make low carbon food choices.
source_quote: ## Dining with Discretion provides resources to empower residents to make low carbon food choices. ## Excess SLC Food Recovery is a partnership between community organizations that diverts consumable food waste from the landfill to food assistance programs.
extraction_rationale: Named program explicitly described as providing resources for low carbon food choices; brief but specific.

policy_statement: Divert consumable food waste from landfill to food assistance programs through the Excess SLC Food Recovery partnership.
source_quote: ## Excess SLC Food Recovery is a partnership between community organizations that diverts consumable food waste from the landfill to food assistance programs. ## Green City Growers was created to expand community garden access for residents by making Cityowned/managed land available for development.
extraction_rationale: Named partnership with a specific diversion action (landfill diversion).

policy_statement: Expand community garden access by making City-owned/managed land available for development (Green City Growers).
source_quote: ## Green City Growers was created to expand community garden access for residents by making Cityowned/managed land available for development. ## Salt Lake City FruitShare diverts surplus fruit from local trees to individuals with low access to healthy foods.
extraction_rationale: Named program using City land access to expand gardens (ecosystem-based intervention); climate link indirect.

policy_statement: Divert surplus fruit from local trees to individuals with low access to healthy foods (Salt Lake City FruitShare).
source_quote: ## Salt Lake City FruitShare diverts surplus fruit from local trees to individuals with low access to healthy foods. ## ZERO WASTE COMMUNITY Salt Lake City's Zero Waste Resolution values what we typically throw away as resources that can be returned to the local economy.
extraction_rationale: Named program with a defined diversion/distribution action; climate relevance via food waste reduction is indirect.

policy_statement: Develop Climate Response Plans within City departments/divisions to reduce emissions and address vulnerabilities to climate change within operations and on a community scale.
source_quote: Climate Response Plans. Internal departments and divisions at the City have developed Climate Response Plans that highlight how to reduce emissions and address vulnerabilities to climate change within operations and on a community-scale.
extraction_rationale: Named plans addressing vulnerabilities (adaptation) and emissions reduction (mitigation) in City operations and community-scale.

policy_statement: Operate the Climate Leaders program to develop municipal employee knowledge and professional skills for climate leadership within City operations.
source_quote: Salt Lake Climate Leaders. The Climate Leaders program engages municipal employees and develops their knowledge base and professional skills to create more effective climate change leaders within City operations.
extraction_rationale: Defined capacity-building program for climate leadership; supports implementation.

source_quote: The CCCAP includes 37 actions that the City will undertake to adapt to climate change. These actions are rooted in eight goals.

extraction_rationale: Concrete infrastructure replacement action to reduce losses and avoid additional desalination demand; listed as a step. Quote includes adjacent bullet to meet 2–3 sentence requirement.

policy_statement: Expand wastewater collection, treatment and reuse to reduce potable water use for city greening and groundwater use in agriculture.
source_quote:
- d. Increasing the use of treated wastewater: The Kingdom is working on expanding the wastewater collection, treatment and reuse to augment the need for potable and groundwater in city greening

and in agriculture. This will help reducing the need for potable water (desalinated water) for city greening and groundwater for agriculture.
extraction_rationale: Specific expansion of wastewater reuse to substitute for desalinated water and groundwater; listed as a step.

parent_statement: Water and wastewater management actions (desalination and water-saving steps)
policy_statement: Encourage rainwater harvesting to augment potable and irrigation water.
source_quote:
Water scarcity in the region presents various challenges to the economic and social growth of Saudi Arabia. Implementing adaptation actions related to water management presents opportunities to reduce exposure and vulnerability.

- e. Rain Water Harvesting: Encouraging rainwater harvesting to augment the need for potable and irrigation water.
extraction_rationale: Specific adaptation action (rainwater harvesting) to augment supplies; listed as a step.

parent_statement: Water and wastewater management actions (desalination and water-saving steps)
policy_statement: Increase storage of surface water runoff through constructing new dams.
source_quote:
- e. Rain Water Harvesting: Encouraging rainwater harvesting to augment the need for potable and irrigation water.
- f. Storage of Surface Water Runoff: Increasing the storage of surface water runoff through constructing new dams in the country.
extraction_rationale: Specific infrastructure action (new dams) to increase runoff storage; listed as a step.

parent_statement: Water and wastewater management actions (desalination and water-saving steps)
policy_statement: Employ new irrigation techniques to minimize groundwater use for agriculture.
source_quote:
- f. Storage of Surface Water Runoff: Increasing the storage of surface water runoff through constructing new dams in the country.
- g. New Irrigation Techniques: Employing new irrigation techniques such as surface irrigation, drip irrigation, sprinkler irrigation, subsurface irrigation, and other techniques will minimize the use of and save a substantial amount of precious groundwater used for agriculture.
extraction_rationale: Specific agricultural water-efficiency measures to save groundwater; listed as a step.

policy_statement: Implement coastal management strategies to reduce coastal erosion and increase blue carbon sinks, including mangrove planting and coral reef restoration.
source_quote: The  Kingdom  will  implement  coastal  management  strategies that are designed to reduce coastal erosion, increase the sinks for blue carbon, maintain related ecosystems and address the threats that climate change poses for marine livelihoods. The Kingdom supports the planting of mangrove seedlings along its coasts. In addition, the Kingdom strengthens and enhances the coral reef restoration program throughout the northwestern Arabian Gulf.
extraction_rationale: Explicit 'will implement' coastal management strategy with ecosystem restoration; includes named hazard and blue carbon sink enhancement.

policy_statement: Plant trees and rehabilitate hectares of land over this decade as part of the Saudi Green Initiative, using recycled water from an irrigation network.
source_quote: Tree planting and rehabilitating hectares of land over this decade as part of the Saudi Green Initiative. Recycled water from an irrigation network will be used for this purpose. The greening initiative will lead to mitigation cobenefits that can be estimated through approved methodologies.
extraction_rationale: Concrete nature-based intervention tied to the Saudi Green Initiative; hectares are unspecified but action is explicit.

policy_statement: Develop mass transport systems in urban areas (metro and bus networks) and expand the Saudi Railway network to reduce traffic and GHG emissions.
source_quote: The Kingdom is taking actions to develop mass transport systems in urban areas such as the development of the metro  and  bus  network  in  Riyadh,  Jeddah  and  Dammam,  which  will  provide  significant  sustainability, environmental and public health benefits. The Kingdom already started construction of metro in Riyadh and in the process of making it operational. The newly built Riyadh metro and bus network will save thousands of car journeys and liters of fuel daily.
extraction_rationale: Specific transport infrastructure actions; section explicitly links these actions to fuel savings and GHG reductions.

policy_statement: Develop NEOM’s LINE aiming for zero carbon emissions, powered by 100% renewable energy and green hydrogen, preserving 95% of nature within NEOM.
source_quote: The project will develop the LINE, a city of a million residents with a length of 170 km that aims to preserve 95% of nature within NEOM, with zero cars, zero streets, zero carbon emissions and to be powered by 100% renewable energy and green hydrogen.
extraction_rationale: Major urban development commitment with explicit zero-carbon and 100% renewables targets; explicit nature preservation target is also stated.

policy_statement: Develop and implement Integrated Coastal Zone Management (ICZM) plans to protect coastal infrastructure.
source_quote:
Integrated Coastal Zone Management Planning (ICZM): Take the necessary action to develop and implement ICZM plans that would take into account the protection of coastal infrastructures such as roads, residential areas, industrial complexes, desalination plants, seaports, etc.;

Early Warning Systems (EWS): Develop and operationalize EWS that would reduce vulnerability due to extreme weather events such as rainstorms, floods and dust storms by increasing resilience of infrastructure;
extraction_rationale: Explicit commitment to develop and implement ICZM plans; concrete adaptation planning measure. Quote includes adjacent adaptation item to meet 2–3 sentence requirement.

policy_statement: Develop and operationalize Early Warning Systems (EWS) to reduce vulnerability to rainstorms, floods and dust storms.
source_quote:
Early Warning Systems (EWS): Develop and operationalize EWS that would reduce vulnerability due to extreme weather events such as rainstorms, floods and dust storms by increasing resilience of infrastructure;

Integrated  Water  Management  Planning:  The  kingdom  has  limited  reserves  of  exploitable  non-renewable groundwater and low recharge rates (2.8 bcm in Arabian Shield) due to arid conditions.
extraction_rationale: Specific adaptation system commitment for named hazards; concrete resilience measure. Quote includes adjacent line to satisfy 2–3 sentence requirement.

policy_statement: Implement the Saudi National Water Strategy 2030 to reform the water and wastewater sector.
source_quote: Integrated  Water  Management  Planning:  The  kingdom  has  limited  reserves  of  exploitable  non-renewable groundwater and low recharge rates (2.8 bcm in Arabian Shield) due to arid conditions. The Saudi National Water Strategy 2030 aims to work towards addressing all the key challenges, leveraging previous and on-going studies, and reform the water and wastewater sector to ensure sustainable development of water resources while providing  affordable  high-quality  services.  Strategic  programs  and  initiatives  include  laws  and  regulations, management, innovation and capacity building, and service quality.
extraction_rationale: Named national strategy and sector reform commitment; concrete policy instrument with specified program components.

policy_statement: Put in place policies to make cities and infrastructure more sustainable, including improving building efficiency to be more resilient to heatwaves.
source_quote: Infrastructure and Cities Designs: Put in place the necessary policies to make cities and infrastructure more sustainable. Improving the cities design by increasing the efficiency of buildings by making them more resilient to heatwaves.
extraction_rationale: Adaptation commitment with explicit hazard (heatwaves) and explicit efficiency mechanism (building efficiency).

policy_statement: Manage response measures as a building block of NDC implementation through international cooperation activities.
source_quote:
As a developing country with  limited sources economy, the Kingdom considers the management of response measures as one of the building blocks of its NDC implementation. The Kingdom recognizes that international

cooperation in addressing response measures is critical in achieving Paris Agreement goals.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella commitment introducing a numbered list of specific activities; qualifies as a policy package for managing impacts of response measures.

parent_statement: Response measures management activities
policy_statement: Conduct socio-economic research studies to assess impacts of external mitigation policies on the Saudi economy, including data and modelling tools.
source_quote:
The Kingdom is actively engaged in the following:

- i. Socio-economic  research  studies  to  assess  the  impacts  of  mitigation  policy  measures  implemented outside Saudi Arabia on the Saudi economy, including data and modelling tools.
- ii. Research and development of technologies that enhance economic competitiveness.
extraction_rationale: Specific listed engagement (i) under response measures; concrete research activity. Quote includes adjacent item to meet 2–3 sentence requirement.

- ii. Research and development of technologies that enhance economic competitiveness.
extraction_rationale: Specific listed engagement (ii); climate linkage is via response measures context and is peripheral.

source_quote:

Technology cooperation based on the approaches outlined in paragraphs 24-29 in decision 5/CP.7 will allow for  the  identification  of  appropriate  technological  options, which  are  consistent  with  national priorities, and domestic human and financial resources to promote enabling environment for economic diversification and technological development (e.g., carbon capture utilization and storage).
- iv. Research into understanding the long-term impacts of response measures on energy market stability and to develop measures that can sustain a stable energy market in the long run.
extraction_rationale: Specific listed engagement (iii) with explicit reference to CCUS; qualifies as mitigation-relevant technology cooperation policy commitment. Quote includes adjacent item to meet 2–3 sentence requirement.

extraction_rationale: Specific listed engagement (iv); concrete research and measure-development activity, though climate relevance is peripheral.

policy_statement: Support completion of rules required for Article 6 operationalization.
source_quote: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia considers voluntary cooperation and approaches referred to in Article 6.2 as well as the mechanism referred to in Article 6.4 of the Paris Agreement as essential for international climate goals. Once  operationalized,  such  cooperation,  approaches  and  mechanisms  including  internationally  transferred mitigation outcomes, will play a role in achieving t he Kingdom's climate change ambitions. They will enhance private  sector  engagement,  advance  innovation  in  business  models,  unlock  investment  flows  and  support cleaner energy technology development.
section_header: 8.4 ARTICLE 6 VOLUNTARY COOPERATION, APPROACHES AND MECHANISM
extraction_rationale: Explicit commitment/position to support completion of rules for Article 6 operationalization; relevant to mitigation cooperation mechanisms.

policy_statement: Operate a national MRV system to track progress toward NDC projects and plans and any modifications thereof.
source_quote: A  national  monitoring,  reporting  and  verification  (MRV)  system  is  a  key  success  factor  for  contribution  to economic diversification and adaptation measures with mitigation co-benefits. Established and managed by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Designated National Authority, the national MRV system is an integral part of the existing  and  future  monitoring  and  reporting  structures.  It  provided  input  into  the  NDC  development  and ambition.
section_header: 9. MONITORING AND REPORTING ON NDC IMPLEMENTATION
extraction_rationale: Concrete institutional mechanism (MRV) to track NDC project/plan progress; qualifies as implementation and reporting policy instrument.
